title: Amphophalus: modeled ₹1,156/qtl left, Chathanoor → Kanjirappally
summary: March 2023: reported amphophalus prices at Chathanoor and Kanjirappally imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 21 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,156 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 86 same-variety market pairs screened for amphophalus in March 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kanjirappally report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: March 2023
scenes.caption: Chathanoor (Kerala) and Kanjirappally (Kerala) both reported amphophalus prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 21 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Chathanoor reported a median ₹4,000 per quintal. Kanjirappally reported a median ₹5,200 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,800/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,800 per quintal, and Kanjirappally was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 99 km by road
scenes.caption: 99 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹21/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,269 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹971 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kanjirappally report, the rule selects 21 of 21 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,156 per quintal (₹887 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Amphophalus route from Chathanoor to Kanjirappally was positive on 100% of matched days in March 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹115,600, or ₹88,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to amphophalus
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹21/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Amphophalus route from Chathanoor to Kanjirappally was positive on 100% of matched days in March 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹115,600, or ₹88,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
